title: Su Qingyao's Determination
next_chapter_hook: Just as the two stood wordlessly facing each other, Su Qingyao suddenly raised her hand and injected a thread of Spiritual Energy into Chen Ji's Brow Center—that was a secret she had never revealed to anyone.

text.content:
Night wind passed through the Bamboo Grove at Tianqing Sect Back Mountain, producing soft rustling sounds. Chen Ji sat alone in the decrepit wooden cabin, the force in his palm still pulsing faintly, like an unruly heart. He could sense the aura of the Tianji Record flowing within his body, intertwining and tangling with this newly acquired power.

Mo Xiansheng's voice still echoed in his mind—'What he gave you was not just power—there is also a sealed memory. But you must think carefully about whether to unseal it or not.'

Chen Ji closed his eyes, trying to organize his thoughts. A sealed memory? Who left it? Why was it sealed? Countless questions surged in his heart, yet he could find no answers. He unconsciously clenched his fist, his knuckles turning slightly white from the force.

At that moment, a light footstep sounded outside the house. Chen Ji's Brow Center twitched—who could be visiting at this hour?

dialogue.content:
"Chen Ji, I know you're inside."

Su Qingyao's voice came from outside the door, cold and clear with a hint of barely perceptible worry: "It's so late, why haven't you rested? I just sensed an unusual fluctuation in your aura..."

text.content:
Chen Ji was slightly stunned. He remembered clearly having set up a formation to isolate his aura, yet she still detected it. This woman's perception was even sharper than he had imagined.

He took a deep breath, rose, and opened the decrepit wooden door. Under the moonlight, Su Qingyao stood quietly in a white dress, her brow bearing a mixture of scrutiny and concern.

dialogue.content:
"Senior Sister Su pays a late-night visit, may I ask what brings you here?"

Chen Ji's voice was as flat as ever, even carrying a hint of aloofness. He lowered his gaze, unwilling to let her see the complex emotions in his eyes.

"You're avoiding me."

Su Qingyao didn't answer his question; instead, she stepped forward, her gaze stabbing at him like a sword: "Chen Ji, what exactly are you hiding? From the moment we were in the scripture repository today, you've been distracted. Though I'm no genius cultivator, I still have some insight."

text.content:
Chen Ji stepped back, but Su Qingyao pressed closer. The faint fragrance from her body reached his nostrils, causing him momentary confusion. This woman always appeared at the most inopportune moments, disrupting all his plans.

Moonlight fell on her cold and beautiful face, and Chen Ji suddenly found it glaring. He turned away, his voice hoarse: "Senior Sister Su, some things, knowing them will only bring disaster."

dialogue.content:
"I am the Inner Disciple Senior Fellow of Tianqing Sect," Su Qingyao's voice turned sharply cold, "if I don't even have the authority to inquire about a disciple's abnormalities, then my position as Senior Fellow is worthless."

She paused, her tone suddenly softening: "Or is it... that you don't trust me?"

text.content:
Those two words were like a dull blade, savagely gouging at Chen Ji's heart. He raised his head and finally met her gaze. Under the moonlight, her eyes were clear as water, yet they reflected his disheveled figure.

Chen Ji suddenly felt a wave of exhaustion. So many years of pretense, so many years of walking alone—he truly was tired.

choice.prompt: Facing Su Qingyao's questioning, how should Chen Ji make his choice?

choices.description: Lay bare everything about the Tianji Record, Mr. Mo, Heavenly Fate Value consumption, and so on, choosing to trust her
choices.risk_hint: If she reveals it, the consequences would be unimaginable

text.content:
Chen Ji fell silent for a long while, then finally let out a soft sigh. He stepped aside to clear the doorway, his voice low: "Come in and talk."

A flash of surprise crossed Su Qingyao's eyes, but she didn't say more, stepping into the humble wooden cabin.

choices.memory_label: 苏青瑶得知天机录秘密

choices.text: Only Tell Part of the Truth
choices.description: Tell her he encountered trouble, but conceal the core secrets of the Tianji Record and Heavenly Fate Value consumption
choices.visible_cost: May Not Gain Her Full Support
choices.risk_hint: If She Discovers the Deception, It May Backfire

text.content:
Chen Ji sighed softly, making a compromise: "I did encounter some trouble. But this matter involves too many things, and I cannot implicate you."

Su Qingyao's brow furrowed slightly, clearly dissatisfied with this answer.

choices.description: Persist in keeping the secret tightly sealed, push her away, and bear everything alone
choices.risk_hint: She will continue to investigate, which might cause bigger trouble

text.content: Chen Ji's expression turned cold as he turned his back to her: "Su Shimei, my decision is made. You don't need to ask further." From behind came Su Qingyao's suppressed anger: "Chen Ji, do you think bearing it alone is protecting others? You're too self-righteous!"

The candlelight in the room flickered, casting their shadows onto the weathered walls. Chen Ji sat on a worn wooden stool while Su Qingyao stood nearby, and the atmosphere between them grew so heavy it became nearly suffocating. Finally, Chen Ji spoke, his voice barely audible yet each word crystal clear: "Su Shimei, have you ever heard of... the Tianji Record?"

dialogue.content: Su Qingyao's pupils constricted sharply. "What did you say?" Her voice trembled slightly. "The Tianji Record... that's an ancient forbidden artifact, said to be able to glimpse Heavenly Secrets and foresee the future. But for a thousand years, no one has ever seen the actual object—it's only mentioned in fragments within classical texts..." She suddenly raised her head, staring intently at Chen Ji: "How do you know this name?"

text.content: Chen Ji didn't respond, instead slowly raising his right hand. A ghostly blue light emerged from his palm, transforming into an ancient jade slip with flowing runes of mysterious intricacy. Su Qingyao gasped sharply, stumbling back two steps: "This is... this is real?" "A fragment," Chen Ji said calmly. "I can use it to foresee events within the next three hours. But each use consumes precious Heavenly Fate."

dialogue.content: "Heavenly Fate..." Su Qingyao repeated softly. "What is that?" "Everyone's destiny," Chen Ji's voice was faint. "My Heavenly Fate is nearly depleted now. If I continue consuming it, at best I'll suffer serious injury, at worst... death and the end of my path." He lifted his gaze, his expression terrifyingly serene: "This is why I've been hiding it all along."

text.content: Moonlight filtered through the window lattice, illuminating Chen Ji's composed face. He'd long since grown accustomed to disregarding life and death—after all, from the moment he'd acquired the Tianji Record, this path had been sealed. Yet at this moment, facing Su Qingyao's eyes filled with shock and heartache, something in his heart faintly trembled.

choice.prompt: Chen Ji revealed everything, but what would Su Qingyao's reaction be?

choices.text: She chooses to stay and accompany him
choices.description: Su Qingyao declares that whatever lies ahead, she'll walk side by side with Chen Ji
choices.visible_reward: Gain a true comrade-in-arms and confidant
choices.risk_hint: She might get hurt protecting you

dialogue.content: Su Qingyao took a deep breath, suddenly stepping forward and grabbing Chen Ji's wrist: "So you were planning to bear it alone? Even hiding it from me?" Her fingertips trembled slightly, yet her voice remained exceptionally firm: "Chen Ji, from now on, your affairs are my affairs. I don't care about the Tianji Record or Heavenly Fate—I only know that you are the person Su Qingyao has chosen."

choices.description: Su Qingyao was shocked by the truth and says she needs time to process it
choices.visible_reward: She will view this matter more rationally

dialogue.content: Su Qingyao fell silent for a long while, her brow furrowed. Finally, she spoke softly: "This matter is too significant—I need time to think. But Chen Ji, I can assure you—I won't tell anyone about this." She paused, her gaze softening: "Give me three days. In three days, I'll give you an answer."

text.content: The night wind suddenly picked up, causing the window lattice to creak. Chen Ji gazed at Su Qingyao's determined eyes as something within him slowly thawed. He'd gone far too long without experiencing this warmth of being trusted, of being chosen. "Thank you." He spoke softly, his voice slightly hoarse. "Whatever choice you make, I won't blame you."

dialogue.content: Su Qingyao shook her head, the corners of her mouth lifting slightly: "You, even now you're still putting on a brave face." She suddenly raised her hand, her fingertips glowing with a faint spiritual light, gently pressing against Chen Ji's brow center. A warm current flowed in through his brow center, causing him to involuntarily close his eyes. "Su Shimei, you..."

text.content:
Su Qingyao's voice rang in his ears, carrying a rare tenderness: "Don't move. I'm传授ing you a heart method called the 'Tongyuan Art'. This technique was originally a保命绝技 passed down by my master back then—cultivated to its extreme, it allows心意相通 with one's closest kin, even..."

She paused, her voice dropping: "Even sharing part of the other's fate."

dialogue.content:
Chen Ji猛地opened his eyes, meeting her clear as water eyes. Under the moonlight, her face was calm and resolute, as if she had long made some decision.

"Su Qingyao, you..."

"I know what you're thinking." She打断him, a faint smile on her lips, "You want to say this path is too dangerous, that you don't want to implicate me, right?"

text.content:
Su Qingyao收回ed her fingers, stepping back. The moonlight勾勒ed her silhouette如仙如画. She望着Chen Ji, eyes holding千言万语, yet ultimately only transforming into one sentence:

"Chen Ji, I never regret my choices in this life. The only thing I regret is not meeting you sooner."

Her voice was soft, yet it heavily fell upon Chen Ji's heart.

dialogue.content:
Chen Ji opened his mouth, yet found his throat seeming blocked by something. Throughout his life he had calculated countless times, seen through the coldness of human hearts, yet no one had ever said such words to him.

"Su Qingyao..."

His voice trembled: "Do you know, if we bind together, it will be一荣俱荣、一损俱损? If something happens to me, you will also..."

"I know." Su Qingyao calmly打断him, "That's why I must learn the Tongyuan Art."

text.content:
Moonlight如水中，filling this simple wooden house. Chen Ji望着this stubborn woman, suddenly feeling a corner of his heart quietly collapse. He thought of Mo Xiansheng's warning, the cost of the Tianji Record, those destined calamities he would face.

But at this moment, he only wanted to reach out and accept the trust she was offering.

After a long while, he finally softly said: "好."

This一声'好', spoken softly, weighed heavier than a thousand jun.

Su Qingyao smiled—that was the first time Chen Ji saw her smile so genuinely. Not the矜持 of an Inner Disciple Senior Fellow, not the淡漠 of a cold senior sister, but the动人光彩 blooming from a woman at her most tender moment.

Outside the window, the night wind gradually stilled, the bamboo grove returned to silence. The two stood facing each other, as if some无形纽带 quietly connected them at this moment.

Just then, Su Qingyao suddenly收敛ed her smile, her expression turning solemn.

"Chen Ji, there's something I must tell you." Her voice lowered, "Beyond the Tongyuan Art, I have another secret—one even my master doesn't know."

She raised her hand, slowly解开ing her collar. Under the moonlight, an奇异纹路赫然appeared at her collarbone, emanating a faint golden glow.

dialogue.content:
"This is the 'Heavenly Fate Mark'." Su Qingyao's voice was calm, yet carried an undetectable bitterness, "I was born carrying this. Those who possess it can transfer part of their heavenly fate to others."

She raised her head, gaze resolute: "I have been waiting for someone worthy of this. Now, I have found them."

text.content:
Chen Ji stared blankly at that golden纹路, his mind a blank void. Heavenly Fate Mark... He had read this name in a残破的古籍. It was a secret method from ancient times used to extend the lives of the dying, requiring one's own heavenly fate as the catalyst.

Those possessing this mark would折损their own lifespan with each transfer.

"You're crazy..." His voice trembled, "Do you know what this means?"

Su Qingyao gently shook her head,重新fastening her collar, covering that golden纹路. She望着Chen Ji, eyes containing not the slightest regret.

"Of course I know." Her voice was soft, yet异常resolute, "But compared to watching you走向death, I would rather exchange my lifespan for you a glimpse of survival."

The night wind rose again,拂过her hair across her face. At this moment, she was no longer the高高在上的Inner Disciple Senior Fellow of Tianqing Sect, just a woman willing to pour out everything for the one she loved.
